news.title: Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin launches satellite internet service to rival SpaceX, Amazon
news.description: Blue Origin is looking to send the first of TeraWave's 5,408 satellites into space in the fourth quarter of 2027.

news.title: China's investment crash raises credit risks for homebuilders, banks, government: Fitch
news.description: China’s sharp investment downturn is amplifying credit risks across the economy, weighing on the credit profiles of homebuilders, banks and local governments.

news.title: China says trade deal with U.S. will 'drain Taiwan’s economy' for American benefits
news.description: China doubled down its rhetorics on the trade agreement between Taiwan and the U.S., saying it would benefit Washington while eroding the island's strategic advantages.

news.title: UK inflation rises to 3.4% in December, above forecasts
news.description: The U.K. inflation rate rose to 3.4% in December, above forecasts of 3.3% from economists polled by Reuters.

news.title: China keeps benchmark lending rates unchanged despite slowing economic growth
news.description: The People's Bank of China held its 1-year and 5-year loan prime rates at 3% and 3.5%, respectively, keeping them unchanged for an eighth straight month.

news.title: Europe weighs using trade 'bazooka' against the U.S. as Greenland crisis deepens
news.description: European countries are reportedly considering retaliatory tariffs and wider economic counter-measures against the U.S.

news.title: China fourth-quarter growth slows to 4.5%, weakest in nearly three years as consumption misses forecasts
news.description: China's economic growth slowed to the weakest level in nearly three years in the fourth quarter as retail sales fell to the lowest level since late 2022.

news.title: Intel's stock jumps 10% to highest since early 2022 ahead of earnings
news.description: Intel has gotten a boost due to optimism around its latest server CPUs and following investments from the U.S. government and Nvidia.

news.title: Meta to begin rolling out Threads ads globally
news.description: Meta launched Threads in July 2023 to compete with Elon Musk's X, formerly known as Twitter.

news.title: Tech stocks rally after Trump says a 'framework' Greenland deal has been reached with NATO
news.description: Comments from President Donald Trump in Switzerland eased worries of a widespread conflict in Greenland.

news.title: Amazon launches AI health-care tool for One Medical members
news.description: The service uses large language models and references patients medical records to answer questions, manage medications and book appointments.

news.title: OpenAI, Anthropic set sights on enterprise customers at Davos
news.description: Enterprise customers account for roughly 40% of OpenAI's business and 80% of Anthropic's business.
